description: Golden set for regression testing of the RAG pipeline. Content assertions are only meaningful against a real LLM provider; with --provider mock the runner validates plumbing (groundedness, not-grounded path, latency, cost accounting). The 'unanswerable' case passes the retrieval gate with semantic embeddings (topic-related corpus) and is defended at the answer layer: the model must admit the information is absent instead of fabricating.
